long_biography.plain_text:
Jasiński moved from trading in his family's business into property development, co-founding the enterprise that became Victoria Dom. From 1998 he supervised sales and marketing, served as vice-president and became chief executive in 2013. The company develops housing in Poland and expanded into Germany through the Victoria House group.

Control sits through Victoria Dom Holding rather than direct ownership of every operating subsidiary. A current bond prospectus records Jasiński with 89.91% of the holding company, which owns all Victoria Dom shares. He also remains president of both boards. The structure makes him the founder-operator and controlling shareholder, while projects, revenue, land, debt and overseas subsidiaries belong to the relevant companies.
